integrity: Exact rational interval sign certificate and analytic proof; no claims of external or independent validation.
scientific_limitations: A constructive deterministic two-atom example with at least two incidence maxima during rising infectious prevalence; no complete peak classification, exact full-epidemic count, stochastic guarantee, or epidemiological clinical significance of the shallow trough. Earlier heterogeneous models already yield multiple waves by other mechanisms.
title: Two incidence maxima before the prevalence apex in an autonomous two-susceptibility SIR epidemic
